title: change-log-2024-12-11-1
summary: The customer support platform for growing teams.
body_markdown:
[Back](https://atlas.so/changelog)


Dec 11th, 2024


🌟 5 new Atlas features to supercharge your support


We know that distance = speed/time. Enjoy powerful new features that give more speed, save more time, and add more distance traveled towards growth. Here’s what’s new:


💌 **Copy To/CC Emails**


You can now copy the To and CC email addresses directly from a ticket, making it easy to share or reference them elsewhere.


🔝 **Scroll to Top of Tickets**


No more endless scrolling! We’ve added a "Scroll to Top" button in tickets, so you can instantly jump back to the beginning of any long thread.


📌 **Pin the Composer**


Keep your draft reply in view while navigating ticket history. With the new "Pin Composer" option, you can write, review, and edit without losing context.


🗑️ **Bulk Delete Tickets**


Inbox getting cluttered? Bulk delete is here! Select multiple tickets at once and delete them in one go, perfect for spam or resolved tickets.


💾 **Save Sent Messages as Canned Responses**


Send a message once, reuse it forever. You can now save any sent message as a canned response with just one click. Efficiency, unlocked.


These updates are live now—go ahead and try them out! Let us know what you think.
